title: Toll Transport Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of MFL Enterprises Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the proposed acquisition in the context of a market for the interstate supply of refrigerated road transportation services between states on the east coast of Australia.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market on the basis that post acquisition, the merged entity would face significant competition from several other suppliers in the relevant market and customers could switch between suppliers of these services in the event the merged firm increased prices or reduced the quality of non-price aspects of its service.
